segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Welcome to Green Vale Agricultural Park.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: As you know, we have only been open a week so you are amongst our first visitors.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We have lots of fascinatingindoor and outdoor exhibits on our huge complex, spreading hundreds of hectares.Our remit is to give 011 educational opportunitiesto the wider public as well as to offer research sites for a wide variety of agriculturists and other scientists.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Let's start by seeing what there is to do.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: As you can see here on our giant wall plan, we are now situated in the Reception block ... here.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: As you walk out of the main door into the park there is a path you can follow.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If you follow this route you will immediatelycome into the Rare Breeds section, where we keep a wide variety of animals which I shall be telling you a little more about later.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Next to this ... moving east ... is the large grazing area for the rare breeds.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Then further east ... in the largest section of our Park is the Forest Area.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: South of the grazing area and in fact just next to the Receptionblock is our Experimental Crop Area.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In the middle of the Park ... this circular area is our lake ....

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: These two small rectangularshapes here ... are the Fish Farms where we rear fish for sale.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: To the east of those is the marsh area which attracts a great many migrant birds.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In the south-eastern corner, beyond the marsh, is our Market Garden area, growing vegetablesand flowers.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: All these areas can be visited by the general public for almost all the year ... although ... please take note of the large signs at the entrance to each area which tell. .. which tell you when certain areas are being used for particularcontrolledexperimentsand are therefore temporarily out of bounds to the public.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You _cansee for yourself what a huge area the park covers and a key question is always, how can we move around?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Well you have a choice of means ... all environmentally friendly ... cars are banned in the park.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We have bicycleswhich you can hire behind the Reception block ... here ... the healthy ones of you can go on foot and finally there's our electric tram, powered from solar cells.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You find more informationabout this at the front entrance.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: A good place to start on your tour is the Rare Breeds section.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We keep goats, sheep and hens and other kinds of poultry.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We are also thinking of bringing in cows and horses but we do not, as yet, have facilities for these bigger animals.The animals are fed in public twice a day and a short lecture given on their feeding habits and nutritionalneeds.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: These are ver/ popular with the public but of course we mustn't lose sight of the main purpose of having this section, not as such to preserve rare animals but to maintainthe diversity of breeds to broaden the ger.e pool for agriculturaldevelopment.Green Vale changeswith the seasons with different events happening at different times of the year.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: May will be perhapsour most spectacularmonth with the arrival of the Canada geese and when our fruit trees will be in full blossom,but there are interestingevents on all year round ... for John Havers, our expert fly fisherman, is currently giving dis~ on the lake.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Each of the sections has its own seasonal calendar ... please consult the summary board at the main entrance.And the final section, as we return to the Receptionblocks, is the orchard.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Do take time to browse round our shop ... there is a wide selection of books on wildlife, some of them written by local authors, and the history of farming, includingorganic farming, somethingwhich the park will be diversifying into in the coming months.
